title: Hardware Engineer
text:
Company Description
Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.
Job Description
Skillset:1. Work experience in Microcontrollers, Analog and digital circuit design, High Speed design.2. Experience in Board level power supply design (On board SMPS Design, Buck,Boost, LDO,Linear)3. Experience in Component selection and Schematics preparation.  4. Experience with design Simulation tools: Orcad, LTSpice/PSpice. Schematics tool expertise in Zucken CR8000 is an added advantage.5. Hands on experience in board bring up and testing6. Knowledge in communication interfaces like I2C,SPI,UART7. Good communication skills for interaction/meetings with the customer and other support team members.8. Able to execute the tasks independently. And Able to mentor the team on technical topics.9. Hands on on Design with EMI/EMC Requirement and design Review from EMI/EMC Perspective.
Qualifications
B.E
Additional Information
8

title: Component Engineer BTV Stator
text:
Company Description
Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.
Job Description
Lead release of the work products (state –materials, norms, production instructions and drawings) incl. release of deviations from design kit by relevant groups and committees (CoC, CoE)Accountable for the realization of the mech. design of the respective components of eMachine (Rotor or Stator) w.r.t interfaces, compliant with the design kitMain contact person and interface to suppliers at a technical level including design topics internal / external for the respective component/assemblyResponsible person to ensure the correct system integration of the componentEvaluation of component changes (impact on functionality, assembly, quality, manufacturability, costs, timing)SkillsDesign of Motor components like Stators including manufacturability (via injection molding, stamping, pressure die cast, laser welding)Develop concepts and perform design calculationsUnderstands manufacturing drawings and derive detailed designKnowledge and application of GD&T including tolerance stack up analysisShould be able to present and communicate across hierarchy design output, proposals, solutions, and resultsUnderstanding of product development / sample phases (QGs)Proficient in UG NX or Creo along with good understanding of SAP for handling releases
Qualifications
BE / BTech in Mechanical or Automobile
Additional Information
7-9 years

title: Engineering Change Management Specialist (Home Comfort - Boilers)
text:
Company Description
Bosch Global Software Technologies Private Limited is a 100% owned subsidiary of Robert Bosch GmbH, one of the world's leading global supplier of technology and services, offering end-to-end Engineering, IT and Business Solutions. With over 27,000+ associates, it’s the largest software development center of Bosch, outside Germany, indicating that it is the Technology Powerhouse of Bosch in India with a global footprint and presence in the US, Europe and the Asia Pacific region.
Job Description
Primary skillset:Lead and coordinate Engineering Change activities across Home Comfort products and processes, ensuring that all changes are evaluated, approved, implemented, documented, and communicated effectively while maintaining product quality, compliance, cost, and delivery targets.Receive, review, and coordinate Engineering Change Requests (ECRs).Drive Engineering Change requests (ECRs) through the approval process.Ensure complete impact assessment before implementation.Monitor change implementation status and closure.Maintain product structures, BOMs, and technical documentation.Ensure design records are updated in PLM systems (e.g., Teamcenter).Support release management activities.Communicate changes to affected teams and sites.Prepare change summaries, reports, and status dashboards.Support management reviews.Below skillset would be an added advantage:Independent handling of design activities & requirement gathering involving concept generation, detailed design, manufacturing drawings and tolerance stack-up analysis.Perform Technical risk analysis.Create CAD model, Assembly and Drafting of Plastic and Sheetmetal components using UGNX and Teamcenter.
Qualifications
B.E. / B. Tech in Mechanical
Additional Information
6 to 8 years
